meaning: 'Universal Beneficence' — the Bodhisattva of practice, rider of the white elephant

pronunciation.approximation: Say "samantabhadra" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Samantabhadra".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "samantabhadra" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Samantabhadra" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Samantabhadra
domains.subtitle: Universal Good
domains.lead: Samantabhadra is universal good, practice. The name means "'Universal Beneficence' — the Bodhisattva of practice, rider of the white elephant" and belongs to the buddhist tradition.

cards.name: Living Tradition

mythology.lead: The stories of Samantabhadra place universal good, practice at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Samantabhadra appears in buddhist tradition as universal good, practice. The name's meaning, "'Universal Beneficence' — the Bodhisattva of practice, rider of the white elephant", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Samantabhadra in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Samantabhadra remains a touchstone for understanding buddhist religion, art, and identity.
